div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Sistem Layanan Janji Temu · 17 Siklus Hidup Bisnis

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Siklus hidup pesanan
pending → paid → confirmed → serving
→ completed → reviewed
pending/paid → cancelled
paid → refunding → refunded
kunci teknisi 3 menit · refund persetujuan dua tingkat pemilik toko→keuangan

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Aktivitas belanja bersama
ongoing → joined → group_paid
ongoing → full → closed
joined → cancelled (belum terbentuk)
Redis NX cegah oversell · harga grup = harga asli × discount_percent

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flash sale
published → ongoing → sold_out / ended
ongoing → seckill_order
row lock stock-1 · batal pesanan tidak isi ulang stok

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Aktivitas potongan
draft → published → used / ended
jumlah setelah kupon ≥ threshold potong otomatis, ambil terbesar · belanja bersama/flash sale dilewati

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Callback pembayaran
buat catatan pembayaran → unified order → frontend memanggil
→ verifikasi callback WeChat → status paid → notifikasi dua sisi

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Kartu member
active → used_up (kunjungan kartu kunjungan habis)
active → expired (kartu bulanan/VIP kedaluwarsa)
active ⇄ frozen (bekukan/buka karena pelanggaran)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Kupon
draft → published → claimed
claimed → used / expired
published → ended (stok habis/kedaluwarsa turun)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transfer hadiah kupon
available → transferred (kode 8 karakter berlaku 7 hari)
→ claimed / expired (deteksi malas pulihkan kupon asli)
Redis NX + row lock cegah double-spend · satu kupon hanya bisa ditransfer sekali

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Kedaluwarsa poin
earned (expires_at = now + 365 hari)
→ used / expired
PointsExpiryTimer pindai 60s · idempoten tiga lapis

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Transfer saldo/poin
validating → locked → completed / failed
client_token berulang → idempotent
Redis NX 30s + row lock kedua pihak (user_id urut naik cegah deadlock)

div.style: color: rgb(2, 44, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Faktur elektronik
pending → issued (invoice_no + issued_at)
pending → rejected (reject_reason)
uk_order_type cegah duplikat, jumlah dibawa server

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pendaftaran teknisi
applied → approved → active
applied → rejected → applied (kirim ulang)
active ⇄ suspended · active → banned

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Autentikasi Token
issued → active → refreshed → active
active → blacklisted (logout/ganti sandi/konkurensi > 3)
active → expired (7 hari tidak dipakai)

div.style: color: rgb(80, 7, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Penutupan akun
active → requested (saldo/pesanan belum selesai/tiket dalam proses dicegat 422)
requested → active (batalkan permohonan)
requested → closing (konfirmasi setelah 72 jam)
anonimkan phone/nickname + status=0

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Penarikan teknisi
pending → approved → processing → completed (saldo WeChat T+1)
pending → rejected → dikembalikan
tinjau pemilik toko → konfirmasi keuangan, dua tingkat

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Tiket layanan pelanggan
open ⇄ open (balasan admin ditambahkan)
open → closed (hanya milik sendiri/hanya open, rating 1-5 opsional)

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Undian roda keberuntungan
on → spun → points / balance / coupon / lose
Redis NX + row lock + random_int ambil berbobot + client_token idempoten

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Hadiah pelanggan berulang
completed → checked → pending → settled / none
konsumsi kedua ke teknisi sama dalam 30 hari · idempoten pada order_id+type
